[JobNimbus](https://www.jobnimbus.com/learn-more/) is a simple CRM and project management tool for contractors.

# How the Hover <> JobNimbus Integration Works

There are currently **two components** to the Hover <> JobNimbus integration:

1. **Project Sync -** allows you to create Hover projects from JobNimbus and enables teams to initiate a Hover measurement request from within a JobNimbus project.





1. **Important:** Project Sync by itself does **not** send Hover data back into JobNimbus.


2. **Report Sync -** allows JobNimbus to pull Hover project data back into JobNimbus once the Hover data is completed. This enables teams to access Hover project information within the JobNimbus project record.





1. **Important:** Report Sync does **not include** data from jobs that were originally created in JobNimbus.


To get the full Hover <> JobNimbus experience, **you will need both Project Sync and Report Sync enabled.**

# Multi-Structure capabilities

Hover supports **multi-structure properties**, meaning multiple structures at the same address (such as a main house, garage, or shed) are included within a **single Hover project (Job ID)**.

This is a change from the previous experience, where each structure was created as a separate project.

### What this means for the JobNimbus integration:

- Users can create jobs in JobNimbus and sync them to Hover

- Once created, users can order measurements through Hover - **including multi-structure properties**

- When the order is complete, users can:





  - View all structures within the same Hover project

  - Download measurements for **each individual structure**

  - Apply those measurements to estimates or material orders for calculations


#### Selecting structures

When working with a multi-structure property, users can choose which structure’s measurements to use.

![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/arfbt5q9/2172923031/007ba89add7210bfff78a2b80688/image_720-1.png?expires=1794342600&signature=cd7506f76433bf257b09ef52a0a438500e4d426d05eb64af6710ceffef567fb8&req=diEgFMB8noFcWPMW1HO4zVlm%2FiPoWtoSBb5pFvhzM2KuyFjvuIaHSGxzed0C%0AZlN%2BVyahfTR%2B%2FioesdQ%3D%0A)

#### Searching for Hover measurements

Multi-structure properties are now grouped under a single address when searching for a Hover report.

![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/arfbt5q9/2172924755/ae4e98639f8e48cf030671d31e16/image_720.png?expires=1794342600&signature=798976a4adf8f77e48ec3a2c405431dfe02d1eae79aecfdf14d43f629b481110&req=diEgFMB8mYZaXPMW1HO4zbDNRe1nbgNcAVBJu4i%2BoRI5UVKMdMgsTe5cF4du%0A6Ni5%2BlBxhAh2Jh0DdCg%3D%0A)

**_Note:_** _Job Nimbus does not currently have the capability to order Hover project data from the mobile apps, but does have the ability to search and link existing Hover data to job/contacts in the mobile app._

You can read more about how to use this Integration in [this JobNimbus support article](https://support.jobnimbus.com/how-do-i-enable-the-jobnimbus-integration-with-hover).
